name: siphon
description: Siphons I/O-heavy work to the Google AI Studio (Gemini) API to save tokens. Hooks block large file reads and redirect to bulk-read/code-write scripts that call Gemini directly.

GEMINI_API_KEY.title: Google AI Studio API key
GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Sent only as the x-goog-api-key header to generativelanguage.googleapis.com.

SIPHON_MIN_LINES.title: Read threshold (lines)
SIPHON_MIN_LINES.description: Line count above which reads are blocked and redirected.
